Play free games online, no download

Arcade a Day is a tiny game studio that ships a brand-new arcade game every single day. Every game is free and runs right in your browser, on your phone or your computer. There's nothing to download, no app to install and no account to make: tap a game and you're playing in a second.

Each game is built around one simple input (tap, hold or let go) plus a twist that makes you want one more try. Runs are short, retries are instant, and your best scores, coins and unlocks stay saved on your device.

Are the games really free?

Yes. Every game on Arcade a Day is free to play in your browser. No download, no install, no sign-up.

When does the new game come out?

A new game drops every day. The timer at the top of the page counts down to the next one.

Do the games work on my phone?

Yes. Every game is made for phones first, held upright, and works just as well with a mouse or keyboard on a computer.

Is my progress saved?

Your best scores, coins and unlocks are saved in your browser on the device you play on.
